systems.system: National registration register and National Registration Card
systems.platform: card index letter and serial number allotted in electronic form; photograph and 10 rolled and 10 plain fingerprints captured by the Registrar
systems.tiers: registrars take applications and forward forms to the Chief Registrar

systems.system: Link between birth registration and the national registration card number
systems.tiers: regulation 6(2)(a): for a person born in Zambia the card number is obtained from the birth registration made for a birth certificate under the Births and Deaths Registration Act; regulation 14: a dead person's card goes to the Chief Registrar for revocation and the issue of a death certificate

note: The 2019 regulations govern identity registration and tie the card number to the birth registration in law; they do not say how or where a birth or death is entered.
